description:
Title: Building a House

You want to build a tree house.
First you collect your requirements, and send them to a tree house architect.
The architect sends you back a draft, which you refine multiple times with additional requirements.
You then create the list of needed materials from the plan.
These materials fall into several categories, you order them from several online stores.
While the order is processed, you send messages to several of your friends to build the house.
After the house is built, you send invitations for a tree house party to your friends.
In order to buy the snacks for the party, a list of people that attend the party is created.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"

                  id="Definitions_BuildingTreeHouse"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/building-a-tree-house">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Requirements" name="Requirements"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Draft" name="Draft plan"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_RefinedRequirements" name="Additional requirements"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_RefinedDraft" name="Refined draft plan"/>

    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Architect" name="Tree house architect"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Store1" name="Online store 1"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Store2" name="Online store 2"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Friends"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Requirements" name="Send requirements" sourceRef="SendTask_Requirements" targetRef="Participant_Architect" messageRef="Msg_Requirements"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_OrderStore2" name="Order materials" sourceRef="SendTask_OrderStore2" targetRef="Participant_Store2" messageRef="Msg_MaterialOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ConfirmStore1" name="Order confirmation" sourceRef="Participant_Store1" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_Store1Confirmed" messageRef="Msg_OrderConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ConfirmStore2" name="Order confirmation" sourceRef="Participant_Store2" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_Store2Confirmed" messageRef="Msg_OrderConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_BuildRequest" name="Ask to build house" sourceRef="SendTask_BuildRequest" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Msg_BuildRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_HouseBuilt" name="Report house built" sourceRef="Participant_Friends" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_HouseBuilt" messageRef="Msg_HouseBuilt"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_You" name="Building a tree house" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectRequirements" name="Collect requirements"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_Requirements" name="Send requirements" messageRef="Msg_Requirements"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_DraftReceived" name="Draft received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_DraftReceived" messageRef="Msg_Draft"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Review_Merge" name="Draft received or refined"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Draft_Check" name="Draft acceptable?" default="Flow_Refine"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_RefineDraft" name="Refine draft"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_RefinedRequirements" name="Send additional requirements" messageRef="Msg_RefinedRequirements"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_RefinedDraftReceived" name="Refined draft received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_RefinedDraftReceived" messageRef="Msg_RefinedDraft"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateMaterialList" name="Create materials list"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CategorizeMaterials" name="Categorize materials"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Order_Split" name="Start ordering and build request"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_OrderStore1" name="Order materials" messageRef="Msg_MaterialOrder"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_Store1Confirmed" name="Store 1 order confirmed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Store1Confirmed" messageRef="Msg_OrderConfirmation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_OrderStore2" name="Order materials" messageRef="Msg_MaterialOrder"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_Store2Confirmed" name="Store 2 order confirmed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Store2Confirmed" messageRef="Msg_OrderConfirmation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_BuildRequest" name="Send build request" messageRef="Msg_BuildRequest"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_HouseBuilt" name="House is built">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_HouseBuilt" messageRef="Msg_HouseBuilt"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Order_Join" name="Join ordering and build request"/>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="ManualTask_SendInvitations" name="Send party invitations"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateAttendeeList" name="Create attendee list"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuySnacks" name="Buy snacks"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_End" name="Party prepared"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_Start" targetRef="Task_CollectRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_CollectRequirements" targetRef="SendTask_Requirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="SendTask_Requirements" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_DraftReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_DraftReceived" targetRef="Gateway_Review_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Gateway_Review_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Draft_Check"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Accepted" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Draft_Check" targetRef="Task_CreateMaterialList">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${draftAccepted == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Refine" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Draft_Check" targetRef="Task_RefineDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_RefineDraft" targetRef="SendTask_RefinedRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="SendTask_RefinedRequirements" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_RefinedDraftReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_RefinedDraftReceived" targetRef="Gateway_Review_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_CreateMaterialList" targetRef="Task_CategorizeMaterials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_CategorizeMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_Order_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_Order_Split" targetRef="SendTask_OrderStore1"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Gateway_Order_Split" targetRef="SendTask_OrderStore2"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_Order_Split" targetRef="SendTask_BuildRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="SendTask_OrderStore1" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_Store1Confirmed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="SendTask_OrderStore2" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_Store2Confirmed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="SendTask_BuildRequest" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_HouseBuilt"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_Store1Confirmed" targetRef="Gateway_Order_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_Store2Confirmed" targetRef="Gateway_Order_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_HouseBuilt" targetRef="Gateway_Order_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Gateway_Order_Join" targetRef="ManualTask_SendInvitations"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="ManualTask_SendInvitations" targetRef="Task_CreateAttendeeList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="Task_CreateAttendeeList" targetRef="Task_BuySnacks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_25" sourceRef="Task_BuySnacks" targetRef="EndEvent_End"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
